audit.whatIsWrong: The chart says Yorick wins rows 0-3, but whys[0] through whys[3] all argue the lane is 'even', a 'farm race', 'balanced'. The page answered its own question two ways.
audit.why: The chart matches the audited mirror (sejuani__yorick.json, unchanged) exactly, so the chart is right and the whys were the stale half.
audit.corrected: whys[0..3] rewritten to state why you actually hold those levels, with the cooldowns that make it true.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike gave no cooldown for either ultimate.
audit.why: Glacial Prison is 120/105/90s; Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100s. Her engage on a 120s timer is what makes 6 a standoff rather than a loss.
audit.corrected: Glacial Prison named with its 120s rank-1 cooldown in spikes[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet defect is real — no Sejuani ability was ever named. Worse, the entire matchup is built on 'track Permafrost's cooldown' and 'engage once it is down'. Permafrost is a 1.5-second cooldown; it cannot be tracked or baited.
audit.why: Permafrost only stuns a target at maximum Frost stacks, and Frost is applied by Winter's Wrath (9/8/7/6/5s). The thing to count is stacks, not the spell. Separately, Fury of the North's Frost Armor grants slow immunity, so Mourning Mist's slow does nothing while it is up — the armour shred and the Mist Walker mark still apply, which is why you lead with the globule anyway. Arctic Assault is her only gap-closer at 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s and 650 range, and Dark Procession is a wall that denies it.
audit.corrected: Count Frost stacks, not Permafrost. Frost Armor eats the Mourning Mist slow but not the mark or the armour shred. Save Dark Procession for Arctic Assault, her one 18-second gap-closer.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Permafrost as the matchup-defining cooldown to bait.
audit.why: 1.5 seconds is not a window. Winter's Wrath and Arctic Assault are.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to Frost stacks, Winter's Wrath at 9s and Arctic Assault at 18s.

edits.before: Sejuani is a tanky, low-damage laner who can't punish you hard early, but her Frost Armor sustains through your ghoul poke. Trade with Q and E marks when her passive is down. Neither of you kills the other outright here.
edits.after: Sejuani is tanky and low-damage, but Fury of the North's Frost Armor gives armour, MR and slow immunity — Mourning Mist's slow does nothing until it breaks. Its mark and armour shred still land, so lead with it and swarm.

edits.before: Her R stun sets up a hard trade or gank, but she lacks the solo burst to kill you if you cage and swarm back. Save W to wall off her engage. Play it as an even, resource-farming phase.

edits.before: Raise 3-4 ghouls, E-mark Sejuani so they leap, W-cage the retreat, and AA alongside the swarm — the ghouls out-damage you both.
edits.after: Raise 3-4 Mist Walkers, Mourning Mist her so they sprint in, Dark Procession her retreat, and AA alongside the swarm.

edits.before: - Sejuani Permafrost: matchup-defining — Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Permafrost is a 1.5s cooldown — count Frost stacks, not the spell. Winter's Wrath (9s at rank 1) is what applies them. - Arctic Assault: 18s at rank 1, her only gap-closer, and Dark Procession denies it. - Eulogy: kill windows only.
